name: Irongauntlet
description: Irongauntlet, an ancient dwarven citadel, sits atop the Maëd Range. Abandoned by the dwarves ages ago, it is now a fortified human city. The citadel’s design made it an invulnerable refuge for Kolbjörn’s people, with a bustling village at its gate. The economy is based on miners and blacksmiths, depending on its trade to survive. The city also serves as a shelter, as during winter or wars, people from many villages in Kolbjörn are guided to hide in Irongauntlet underground citadel. People live in a village on the surface, as the dwarven citadel is a maze of tunnels and hidden paths where miners venture to gather ore. Yet, recently, the roar of unknown creatures has been echoing there, and small earthquakes are causing destruction and fatalities. Some shamans interpret these as mountain spirits’ anger, believing a misdeed of one or a group of miners. The inhabitants are divided. The Stonecircle group attributes the tremors to lurking monsters. They advocate for sealing off the mines and reinforcing structures to prevent collapses. On the other hand, the Mountain Warriors argue that the solution lies in facing these creatures head-on. They fear that closing the passages will lead the monsters to increase, amplifying the earthquakes and destroying the city. Meanwhile, the Spirit Whispers see the tremors as messages from the spirits. They claim that closing or venturing into the mountains will worsen the situation and believe in doing sacred rituals, sacrifices, and finding who angered the spirits to punish them. As iron reserves dwindle, miners and blacksmiths face a looming famine. They are torn between the shamans and warriors while dreading the Stonecircle solution. Amidst the turmoil, groups recruit adventurers for support, with the Mountain Warriors seeking heroes to venture into the undergrounds. While the truth is unknown, the Kolbjörners may soon know why the dwarves abandoned Irongauntlet.
